material.acceptance_criteria: CI exports the moba and duel-routes images twice and compares bytes; mapexport prints one error line and exits 1 on a bad manifest.
material.description: pages.yml 'Pack the moba game' comment says two runs give the same bytes; no step compares them. rust/crates/mapexport/src/main.rs:8-21 uses expect/panic! for every error (backtrace noise, exit 101). data crate encode.rs and validate.rs iterate HashMap/HashSet (validate.rs:31,206) so order dependence is plausible if any iteration reaches output.
